title: 40Ar/39Ar Geochronology
consumed_by: Noble Gas MS instrument TAPPs registering 40Ar/39Ar procedures.
evidence: Schaen et al. 2021, GSA Bulletin 133, 461-487, Table 4
notes: Layer 3. Overlays Column F on all six Module_Geochronology fields and five of the six Module_ReportingCore fields, and adds four fields specific to 40Ar/39Ar. The J value maps onto ReportingCore's 'Calibration Factor and Determination Method' with no strain, which was the main thing this module was built to test.
generalisation_candidates: Neutron Irradiation Conditions — fission-track EDM has the same requirement (Kohn et al. 2024).
Gas Extraction and Release Schedule — (U-Th)/He stepped heating and continuous ramped heating have the same requirement (Flowers et al. 2024).

Neutron-Induced Interfering Isotope Production Ratios — structurally similar to the Interfering Species / Interference Correction Method pair already present in seven TAPPs, though the physics is nuclear rather than spectral. Revisit if a general interference module is built.
decisions: Column I (Keyed By) added to every field 2026-08-11 under Rule 7; owned_columns gained "I". Module-owned, so the value is authoritative for all consumers.
2026-08-11: Keyed By revised under the strengthened Rule 7 invariants — every key in use must have exactly one 'defines:' field, and 'defines: X' is used only where another field is keyed by X.
2026-08-11: declares source_comment (Rule 6.11) so composition stamps field provenance into Column G of system variants. Documentation only — not read by validate_tapp.py and not part of the schema.

2026-08-25: Step 1 of the Description/Purpose split. Column B keeps the Description sentences; the Purpose sentences moved to consumer-owned Column J. Move only — no text reworded or deleted. Routing and rules in analysis/Step1_Routing_ALL_MODULES_2026-08-25.csv.

2026-08-25: Column J `Purpose` declared as an OVERLAY column, not an owned one. The module supplies a default Purpose that a consumer inherits on composition and owns thereafter — the same relationship Column F already has. Added after Step 1 stripped Purpose sentences from Module_ArAr's descriptions with nowhere to put them, because ArAr is composed into no TAPP: a module with no consumer had no destination for its own Purpose text, so the text was lost. Modules now hold it themselves.

2026-08-25: three roadmap notes were removed from field descriptions and relocated here, where they belong — they addressed the library maintainer, not a researcher filling the field. Gas Extraction and Release Schedule: (U-Th)/He and continuous ramped heating have equivalent requirements (Flowers et al. 2024) — candidate for generalisation once a stepped-heating system module exists. Neutron Irradiation Conditions: fission-track dating by the external detector method has an equivalent requirement (Kohn et al. 2024, 'Irradiation reactor') — candidate for generalisation once a second irradiation-based system module exists. Neutron-Induced Interfering Isotope Production Ratios: candidate for a future general interference module.

2026-08-27: RETIRED. Built ahead of its technique under Rule 6.10 and composed into no TAPP for the whole of its life, which the validator reported as `module-unused` at every run. Retired rather than deleted: the 16 fields are real design work, four of them usable by nothing else (Neutron Irradiation Conditions, Neutron-Induced Interfering Isotope Production Ratios, Gas Extraction and Release Schedule, F Value (40Ar*/39ArK)), and the planning table still carries Static Noble Gas & Nitrogen Mass Spectrometry at priority H — the instrument half of the composition this module was the system half of. Moved to Archive/Superseded Modules/ alongside Group1 and ReportingCore; the module register carries the row forward as `retired — carried`. Revive it from there if the noble-gas TAPP is built.
